Letter of Support for Ms Olga Glazova (Global Talent – Arts & Culture)

To whom it may concern,

My name is Alevtina [Surname], and I represent Golden Age Productions, a cultural events producer focused primarily on classical programming, alongside neoclassical and contemporary music. Golden Age Productions was established to deliver carefully curated cultural entertainment—bringing together musical and intellectual content and presenting it in elegant formats and venues.

I am writing to express my strong support for Ms Olga Glazova, an outstanding gusli performer, singer, and songwriter, in her application under the UK Global Talent route. In May 2025, I received a proposal to present a concert centred on the gusli—an instrument rarely heard in the UK—developed in collaboration with the remarkable musician Nikita Sukhikh, whose work I have followed for a long time. The featured gusli artist for this project was Olga Glazova, whose artistry brings genuine novelty and contemporary relevance to this ancient instrument.

In my work as a producer, I am open to new creative ideas; however, I distinguish carefully between “unusual” collaborations created merely for their novelty and true innovation grounded in artistic seriousness, professional discipline, and a meaningful relationship to classical music culture. In Ms Glazova’s case, what immediately stood out was her strong academic foundation and her ability to build something genuinely new from it. Ms Glazova is classically trained and is a graduate of a leading Russian conservatoire tradition. Beyond formal training, she has contributed new artistic vision to the instrument itself—through the development of repertoire, performance practice, and innovative approaches to gusli sound and technique.

The concert was an unequivocal success. The hall was full, and, most importantly, the audience response reflected deep engagement: the attentive silence throughout the performance—and the sustained warmth at the conclusion—communicated more than any promotional wording could. In artistic terms, Ms Glazova introduced a completely new sonic palette for UK listeners: the distinctive timbre of the gusli combined with her vocal quality created a sound world not commonly encountered in Great Britain. Her musicianship sits comfortably alongside top-tier classical performance standards, and her ability to deliver musical expression with clarity and depth was evident throughout.

I believe Ms Glazova is a genuinely unique artist who should be supported in expanding her contribution to the UK’s cultural life. The UK offers an exceptional historical and institutional cultural environment in which her work can develop on a larger scale—through concerts, collaborations, recordings, and curated programmes that bridge classical foundations with contemporary creativity. I support her ambition to establish a sustained platform not only in the UK but internationally.

From a practical standpoint, I also confirm my intention to continue working with Ms Glazova. I plan to produce additional events featuring her, and I am actively considering an annual concert format in which she would be a key participant. The combination of an uncommon instrument, a distinctive vocal timbre, and a serious classical educational foundation offers precisely the kind of artistic identity that contemporary UK audiences and venues increasingly value.

For these reasons, I fully support Ms Olga Glazova’s Global Talent application and believe she will make a significant and distinctive contribution to the cultural life of Great Britain.

Yours faithfully, Alevtina [Surname] [Role / Title], Golden Age Productions [Phone] | [Email] [Website]
